name: Aider
tagline: AI pair programming in your terminal
description: Aider lets you pair program with LLMs to start a new project or build on an existing codebase. It maps your codebase, works with 100+ languages, integrates with git, and can lint and test its own changes.

name: SWE-agent
tagline: Takes a GitHub issue and tries to automatically fix it
description: SWE-agent takes a GitHub issue and tries to automatically fix it using your LM of choice. It can also be used for offensive cybersecurity or competitive coding challenges.

name: Cursor
tagline: Your coding agent for building ambitious software
description: Cursor is an AI coding agent available as a desktop app and CLI, used for planning, generating and reviewing code changes across a codebase.

name: Devin
tagline: Your team's autonomous software engineer
description: Devin runs in the cloud or on your machine, spins up its own VMs to build and test in its own browser, and works until a pull request is ready to merge.

name: GitHub Copilot
tagline: Your AI coding agent
description: GitHub Copilot is GitHub's AI coding agent, integrated into the editor and GitHub itself, for code completion, chat and autonomous coding tasks.

name: Elicit
tagline: AI for research and decision-making
description: Elicit searches millions of academic papers and generates structured research reports with citations, helping researchers work from evidence faster.

name: Consensus
tagline: AI for research
description: Consensus searches and analyzes peer-reviewed literature, drawing on 250M+ research papers including licensed full-text content, to answer research questions with citations.

name: Perplexity
tagline: Fast, accurate answers from trusted sources
description: Perplexity is an AI answer engine that searches the web and cites its sources, with a 'Computer' mode that can carry out longer research and work tasks.

name: You.com Search API
tagline: Leading web search APIs for AI
description: You.com provides web search, content extraction and grounded-answer APIs built for AI agents and LLMs to search the live web.

name: OpenAI Deep Research
tagline: An agent that conducts multi-step research on the internet
description: Deep research is an OpenAI agent capability that independently browses the web, reasons across sources and produces a cited research report from a single prompt.

name: Julius AI
tagline: AI tools for Excel, presentations, websites and more
description: Julius AI is a chat-based data analysis agent that can build models, charts and reports from your data and generate spreadsheets, slides and websites.

name: PandasAI
tagline: Chat with your database or your datalake
description: PandasAI makes data analysis conversational: it answers natural-language questions over SQL, CSV and parquet data using LLMs and retrieval-augmented generation.

name: Hex
tagline: The analytics platform for humans and agents
description: Hex is a collaborative data notebook and analytics platform that pairs human analysts with AI agents to explore data and build dashboards.

name: Akkio
tagline: The AI workflow automation platform
description: Akkio connects a team's data and knowledge into one platform so strategists, data scientists and engineers can turn documents and signals into shared insights.

name: Deepnote
tagline: The open data workspace built for humans and agents
description: Deepnote is a collaborative data science notebook with an Agent Workspace for exploring data, generating dashboards and automating insights alongside AI agents.

name: Browser Use
tagline: Open-source AI browser agents
description: Browser Use is an open-source Python library for building AI agents that control a real browser, plus a hosted cloud API with stealth browsers.

name: Skyvern
tagline: Automate browser-based workflows with AI
description: Skyvern uses LLMs and computer vision to navigate websites and fill out forms, automating browser workflows without site-specific scripts.

name: Claude Computer Use
tagline: Lets Claude control a computer screen
description: Computer use is an Anthropic API capability that lets Claude view a screen and control a cursor and keyboard — clicking, typing and scrolling like a person.

name: Browserbase
tagline: Give your agents access to the whole web
description: Browserbase provides reliable, programmable headless browser infrastructure — session management, search and fetch APIs — for AI agents operating on the web.

name: Comet Browser
tagline: A personal AI assistant built into the browser
description: Comet is Perplexity's AI browser, which can research, compare, summarize and take action across tabs on a user's behalf.

name: Fin
tagline: The highest performing customer agent
description: Fin is Intercom's AI customer service agent, with resolution rates averaging 76% across 12,000+ customers and pricing tied to resolutions.

name: Decagon
tagline: The AI concierge for every customer
description: Decagon builds AI agents for customer support that handle conversations end to end across chat, voice and email for enterprise support teams.

name: Ada
tagline: AI customer service agents for enterprise CX
description: Ada provides AI customer service agents that resolve support conversations autonomously across channels for large enterprise support teams.

name: Zendesk AI Agents
tagline: Advanced AI agents for CX
description: Zendesk AI Agents are built into the Zendesk support platform to autonomously resolve customer conversations using a company's existing help content and data.

name: Crescendo
tagline: AI-native customer experience platform
description: Crescendo's CX platform aims to replace a support team's chatbot, ticketing, QA and workforce tools with one AI-native system that improves with every conversation.
